profile.reading:
This facility, recorded in OpenStreetMap under the name "STACK MILL1B," is most plausibly STACK Infrastructure's MIL01B building in the Milan, Italy metro area, the second of three buildings on the company's 27-megawatt, 25-acre MIL01 campus. As documented on its sibling record, STACK's own current site spells this campus's codes as MIL01A, MIL01B, and MIL01C rather than the "MILL1A"/"MILL1B" spelling found in the OSM source data, a discrepancy noted honestly here rather than silently corrected, since the exact-spelling match could not be independently confirmed this session. With that caveat, MIL01B carries 12 megawatts of IT capacity across 209,466 square feet, matching this record's apparent scale, alongside sibling buildings MIL01A at 12 megawatts and 156,723 square feet and MIL01C at 3 megawatts and 28,955 square feet. Milan is STACK's largest single European market, with 11 campuses (MIL01 through MIL11) totaling 399 of the company's 743-megawatt EMEA footprint spanning 21 campuses across seven European countries. STACK describes Milan as "Italy's economic capital" and one of "Europe's fastest-growing data center markets," citing global subsea cable connections and a strong terrestrial fiber network. STACK, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, reports roughly 8.5 gigawatts of capacity built or under development company-wide across 24 global markets. No comune-level address, year of completion, or named power-grid connection is disclosed on STACK's public site for this building, and no independent Italian press coverage could be located this session because search-tool quota was exhausted. Tenant identities are not publicly disclosed.

STACK's EMEA operations are led by a regional executive team including an interim chief executive, a chief financial officer, and a chief operating officer specific to the European business, reporting up to the company's group-wide board chairman, a structure that reflects the scale and relative maturity of STACK's European expansion, of which the Milan market, its largest in Europe by both campus count and capacity, forms a substantial part.
profile.research_note: Same naming discrepancy as its sibling record (osm:way/524879451, "MILL1A"): this OSM record is named "STACK MILL1B" with osm ref MILL1B, most plausibly a variant transcription of STACK's own MIL01B code (12MW/209,466sqft matches this record's scale within the 3-building, 27MW, 25-acre MIL01 campus), but this was not independently confirmed against an exact-spelling source and is flagged as probable rather than certain.
